_about: Session days that are not in badminton-scores.xlsx yet. The build reads them after the workbook's day tabs. If the workbook later gets a tab with the same name (for example "W8 Day 1"), the tab is used and the entry here is ignored. Score order follows the teams: score[0] is team a, score[1] is team b. ratings are the 1-5 ratings used on court that day.

days.source: Scoring-app screenshot, Week 8 day 1 (six players, no Bhanu)
